review_description: I appreciated the information on your website, it was invaluable in helping decide which solar system to choose and eventually which installer to hire. Thank you so much for providing all that information.

This was the best quote, the most professional and the most polite peole I dealt with. There was not a problem to hard or a question they couldn't answer. No BS about the amount you can get in feed in tariffs. In NSW that's between 6-8 cent per kilowatt. Top quality German Panels and SMA Inverter. Installation was quick about 2 weeks (that was slowed down because of bad weather).So, if you are looking for quality product and excellent service contact Albert and he will only be too happy to help you.
The sales person is honest and did come down to inspect the site.
JTSolar was a great company to deal with and I would highly recommend them.
Mention my name (Viv) for their special deal!
